5809.note_text: An example of a special-purpose temperature probe is an esophageal-stethoscope probe in which a temperature sensor is loosely contained within a plastic tube; however the primary purpose of the probe is to transmit chest cavity sounds through the air or gas within the tube to a stethoscope attached to its open end.

5807.note_text: a special-purpose temperature probe is a probe that incorporates a temperature sensor and has also other functions
